notes.title: Nick Reckless in the Curse of the Lost Cause now available in French !
notes.content:
Time goes by so fast ! It's already been a year since the launch of [b]Nick Reckless in the Curse of the Lost Cause[/b].

During this year's showcase at the StunFest event in France, many people asked me to support french. 
So, after a few rewrite of the technology, voila ! [b]The game is now available in French. :-)[/b]
This update also adds some bug fixes and a few visual changes.

Major content update:
[list]
[*]The game now supports French.
[/list]
Minor content update:
[list]
[*]The title screen and the control screen visuals have been updated.
[*]The game now pauses during gameplay when the Steam overlay is displayed.
[*]The pause screen is now visible during a fade to black.
[*]The game resolution better adapts to the window resolution to keep a correct pixel aspect ratio.
[*]Saber-tooth tigers shouldn't be floating around anymore in the ruins levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Release note for 10/14/2022 update
notes.content:
This update adds support for French language. It also adds a few bug fixes and some aesthetic changes.

[General]
- The game now supports French language.
- The title screen visuals have been updated.
- The control screen visuals have been updated.

[Bug fix]
- The game is now paused during gameplay when the Steam overlay is displayed.
- The pause menu is now visible when the game is paused during fade to black.
- The screen size better adapts to the monitor resolution to keep a correct pixel aspect ratio. This avoids some visual glitches on non widescreen (16:9) resolutions.
- Sabertooth tigers shouldn't be floating around anymore in the ruins levels.
